fusions.name: Decree Bolt
fusions.desc: Throws a bolt that deals 32 damage to the first enemy it meets. Your party deals 20% more damage for 12 seconds after it hits.

fusions.name: Summary Judgment
fusions.desc: A pointed order that deals 22 damage, up to 2 times that at maximum range. It only strikes a target at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Staged Proclamation
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 10 seconds, and fights with 1 more power while it holds.

fusions.name: Standing Orders
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 7% sooner, and your armour rises by 5%.
